title: How many of Allerton's licensed family child care homes will close during 2027, two to four years after a start-up grant round licensed a wave of home providers
subdomain: event history and life course analysis (a closure hazard read on the provider's family life course, the summer before her youngest own child starts kindergarten, from the licensing record's home-months and the capacity worksheets' children)
prompt_shape: one count to the nearest 50; subsidised child-days by region and half-year; subsidy money paid to the homes by region and quarter of the payment run

distractors.why_relevant: the quality ratings of the homes, a natural covariate for which homes close
distractors.why_unused: no figure reads it; ratings carry no information on closure in this record
distractors.ruled_out_by: the call's model and every ask read other files

distractors.why_relevant: the food program claims of the homes, a measure of how many children each home serves
distractors.why_unused: no figure reads it; the call reads the licensing record and the asks the subsidy runs
distractors.ruled_out_by: the prompt's tables, both on the subsidy

distractors.why_relevant: the inspectors' visits to the homes, with complaint investigations
distractors.ruled_out_by: the prompt's tables, both on the subsidy

distractors.why_relevant: the prices homes charge by county and age group, the economics of running a home
